[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/0d77138cf7a1f9c4c9cf3af5c4b40305826775f2.png"][/img][b]Dear friends,[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/fc8c88303333c72756ffb5c2c4b5daab292f6189.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]We would like to share with you some early materials from the second part of "Sex with the Devil"![/i][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/8f97033bf7526c67b58abb71ee3c5cc7174a962a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Here is a fragment of the text [u](without proofreading and editing)[/u] and some concept arts.[/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/78ad992b5d2ff8b3c7e76d34c5ab705bdf57f74e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/b2c3d73562a4cf27b42ba391169c3af909386eee.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/41964d06ba4c8396420cf4cafacd11b0348e3d06.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/90ca29c675c4aa38e8249e676b165a7c9747e06c.png"][/img][/p][h2] [u][i][b]Also, do not forget about the upcoming release of the [/b][/i][/u][b][i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608630/FUTA_RUNNER_Big_Dick_Edition"]"Futa Runner"[/url][/u][/i][/b][b][i][u] game! If you could add it to your wishlist, it would be a great help for us!!! [/u][/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][h2][b][i][u]If the release is successful, we will be able to add a lot of new content to the Devil's sequel![/u][/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/f868109e11a42d3c28bbba21fd7c54e77aca117c.jpg"][/img][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]Thank you for your support!

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/b16249e80566b628ac6c45c7db300cb699c68e5e.jpg"][/img][/h3]

notes.title: SEX, PLEASE!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear friends![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/b0e0322353ea226fbc8b01db33723a130949c0e2.png[/img]

[i]It's time to share the news with you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/4c6ee44d76cecaf35cb8f0a15793fa6989e38c69.png[/img]

The development of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2501730/Sex_with_the_Devil_2/]"Sex with the Devil 2"[/url][/b] is going slowly [u]because we need to develop  a large number of animated battle scenes and circus sex shows[/u]. We spend two months for one such scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/9fc65bc3a1b4c34aa8c7999e8a9a974153fbce72.png[/img]

[b]Release of the sequel will take place only in the [u]middle or end of 2024[/u].[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/06c92f20da9f53f8dff8bbf1af3ed334d7593988.png[/img]

[i]But to brighten your waiting, we decided to create a small, but [b]very unusual game![/b] It [b]focuses on sex scenes[/b], not on plot cut-scenes with battles. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/52036329df6750f3f758c94f5ffeeccc91326081.png[/img]

[b]We present to your attention - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608620]"Sex, Please"[/url].[/b]

[u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608620]You can add "Sex, Please" to your Wishlist now![/url][/b][/u][/h2]
